plugin.before: jsx('h1', { style: { fontSize: 24, lineHeight: 1.25, letterSpacing: '-0.02em', margin: '0 0 8px' }, children: 'Stock Runway' }),
plugin.after: jsx('h1', { style: { fontSize: 24, lineHeight: 1.25, letterSpacing: '-0.02em', margin: '0 0 8px' }, children: 'Inventory Manager' }),

plugin.before: ctx.register({ id: 'quick-view', area: PALETTE_AREA, data: { id: 'stock-runway.quick-view', label: 'Stock Runway: quick view', keywords: ['stock', 'inventory', 'runway'], run: open } })
plugin.after: ctx.register({ id: 'quick-view', area: PALETTE_AREA, data: { id: 'stock-runway.quick-view', label: 'Inventory Manager: quick view', keywords: ['stock', 'inventory', 'runway'], run: open } })

plugin.before: ctx.register({ id: 'quick-view-keybind', area: KEYBINDS_AREA, data: { id: 'stock-runway.quick-view', label: 'Stock Runway: quick view', category: 'view', defaults: ['mod+shift+i'], run: open } })
plugin.after: ctx.register({ id: 'quick-view-keybind', area: KEYBINDS_AREA, data: { id: 'stock-runway.quick-view', label: 'Inventory Manager: quick view', category: 'view', defaults: ['mod+shift+i'], run: open } })

plugin.before: ctx.register({ id: 'route', area: ROUTES_AREA, title: 'Stock Runway', data: { path: '/stock-runway' }, render: () => jsx(RecoveryBoundary, { ctx, children: jsx(Page, { ctx }) }) })
plugin.after: ctx.register({ id: 'route', area: ROUTES_AREA, title: 'Inventory Manager', data: { path: '/stock-runway' }, render: () => jsx(RecoveryBoundary, { ctx, children: jsx(Page, { ctx }) }) })

plugin.before: ctx.register({ id: 'nav', area: SIDEBAR_NAV_AREA, data: { path: '/stock-runway', label: 'Stock Runway', codicon: 'graph' }, order: 70 })
plugin.after: ctx.register({ id: 'nav', area: SIDEBAR_NAV_AREA, data: { path: '/stock-runway', label: 'Inventory Manager', codicon: 'graph' }, order: 70 })

plugin.before: ctx.register({ id: 'palette', area: PALETTE_AREA, data: { id: 'stock-runway.open', label: 'Open Stock Runway', keywords: ['inventory', 'stock', 'runway'], run: () => host.navigate('/stock-runway') } })
plugin.after: ctx.register({ id: 'palette', area: PALETTE_AREA, data: { id: 'stock-runway.open', label: 'Open Inventory Manager', keywords: ['inventory', 'stock', 'runway'], run: () => host.navigate('/stock-runway') } })

plugin.before: ctx.registerSettingsPage?.({ id: 'settings', title: 'Stock Runway', icon: 'graph', render: () => jsx(Settings, { ctx }) })
plugin.after: ctx.registerSettingsPage?.({ id: 'settings', title: 'Inventory Manager', icon: 'graph', render: () => jsx(Settings, { ctx }) })

tools.before: return json.dumps({"error": "Stock runway could not read the selected source."}, separators=(",", ":"))
tools.after: return json.dumps({"error": "Inventory Manager could not read the selected source."}, separators=(",", ":"))
